sections.label: urine
sections.text:
Haemorrhages. Mouth and anus chiefly affected.

514

sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Irritable and peevish; fretful. Loud moan-
ing. Great restlessness. Sad, taciturn; suffers in silence.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Vertigo: occiput heavy as if filled with lead.
Sound of voice is intolerable. Pain as if brain were
crushed.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text: Heemorrhoge : much sneezing.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Lower jaw fallen; pimples and freckles; lips
raw, dry, cracked.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Tongue dry, leathery, paralyzed. Deep
ulcers on tongue. Hard lumps in tongue. Epithelioma ;
edges bluish-red. [Carhol. ac.] Aphthous mouth.
Gums and glans swollen. Fetid breath. Sordcs on

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Uvula swollen. Ulcers and false membrane.
(Edematous, dark, taw. Attempted swallov»dng pro-
duces spasm and choking.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Cnnnot bear sight or thought of meat. At
times, ravenous appetite and constant desire to drink.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Tendency to involuntary evacuations while
urinating. Hcemorrhoids most sensitive to all touch;
even sheet of toilet paper is painful. Anal itching and
prolapsus ani while urinating. Hcemorrhoids during
pregnancy; bluish, hot, iinth violent stitches.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Pulse rapid, feeble, and small. Intermits
every third beat.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Cannot urinate without having bowels move
at same time.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses appear too soon. Leucorrhoca.
During menses, soreness of anus. Ulcer in genitals.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Heavy, painful, and weak. Tottering
gait. Pain in tendo- Achilles.

% SJkin. — Papular and vesicular eruptions, with great


itching. \Rhus.’\ Carbuncles; foul-smelling ulcers on
lower extremities. Scarlet fever, livid, with petechiae;
scanty eruption.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Cold extremities. Heat without thirst.
Typhoid types, stupid. Haemorrhages. Restlessness.
Involuntary discharges. Bed-sores. Pulse rapid and
feeble. Excessive prostration.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
li^orse, in damp weather, before mid-
night. Better, lying on left side.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
- Compare : Bhos. ac.; Ars.: Bapt.
Follows well after Bry. and Rhus.

Antidote : Bryonia.

■ Gums sw^ollen, bleeding, ulcerating. ^Scorbutis.

"Taste and Tongue. ■Everything tastes sw^eet; beer tastes

■ Taste: acrid and putrid, like rotten eggs, with j^tyalism;

in throat like rancid grease.

■ Tongue: heavy as lead, hinders talking; feels lame, sore;

bases and vesicles; thick, dark, almost whole mouth
and fauces covered with a greyish white membrane;
painful blisters with burning.

■ Edges of ulcer and surrounding parts of a blue color.

^Cancer of tongue.

■ Tongue sore and bluish; deep ulcer with black base and

inverted edges; atrophy of tongue making him speak
in a thick, hoarse voice ; hard lump on side of tongue,
growing into a hard, deep, warty ulcer, about size of a

much so that speaking and expectoration is very diffi-
cult. ^Cancer of tongue.

■ All the time pushing finger down throat, or keeps claw-

ing mouth, as if some obstruction must be pulled out
of throat.

■ Greyish white deposits on mucous membrane of throat,

succeeded by ulcers.

■ Well defined dead white patches, varying in size, over

velum and pillars of palate, tonsils and posterior por-
tion of pharynx, similar to false membrane in diph-
theritic angina.

■ Thin, excoriating discharge from nose, intermittent pulse

and loss of appetite. ^Diphtheria.

■ Gangrenous angina; internal parts bluish red, dark;

aphthous ulcers ; epithelium of tongue comes off in large
brown pieces; fetor oris. ^Scarlet fever.

■ During attack of scarlatina, on third day, tonsils and

forward ; continual desire to hawk, with difficult expec-
toration of tougii mucus; swallowing almost impossible.

a gangrenous ulcer, covered with tough mucus, which
draws out in strings ; fetor oris ; swallowing of water very
difficult, producing cough; pulse small, very fast; pale,
anxious face. ^Diphtheria.
